explanation: The Andrews–Curtis conjecture: every n-tuple normally generating the free group F_n is AC-equivalent to the standard basis. The moves are the standard ones (invert a relator, multiply r_i by r_j for i ≠ j, permute, conjugate by an arbitrary word), and equivalence is the generated equivalence relation, matching Myasnikov–Myasnikov–Shpilrain and Wikipedia. The statement is faithful and open.
